name: a-gene-function-question-is-not-a-build
rationale: A question whose answer is one gene's annotation asks for an explanation, so it stays a follow_up_question and reaches no building tool. This is the counterpart of a-count-question-is-a-build: the rule that makes a count a build must not make every question one. A turn classified as a question persists no strategy AST.

provenance.curatorNote: The gene is a named annotation lookup, not a set.
